Interpretation: the corpus is CASIA v2.0 modified (uncompressed images recompressed, class-balanced) — real tampered photographs, not edits this project generated. Splits are grouped by source photograph so a scene cannot appear in two folds, and the leakage check passed. The limiting factor is now the 143-feature handcrafted bank, not the data. Region localisation is measured, not assumed: tiled inference reaches Dice 0.112 and ELA tiles 0.107.
